pairs.evidence: pipeline/jobfit/llm/config.py:69 accepts any positive timeoutS and pipeline/jobfit/llm/base.py:505 floors a per-attempt timeout only to _MIN_ATTEMPT_S (1 s), and registry.py:363 hands that value straight to the Claude CLI engine, so a routing row with timeoutS 1 kills every CLI spawn and quietly moves that use case onto the deterministic floor, which the golden path says must be floored to a sane minimum. The layer composes pipeline/jobfit/claude_cli.py (not in any context's file_paths), where most of the transport is realized.

techniques.evidence: pipeline/jobfit/llm/registry.py:189 provider_availability returns (usable, descent_reason) for every provider; the zero-token authorization proof is pipeline/jobfit/claude_cli.py:806 `claude auth status --json`, with offline_policy checked before the filesystem (claude_cli.py:746).

pipeline/jobfit/llm/registry.py:96 _cli_strip_api_key picks the billing direction once per lane at the registry door; pipeline/jobfit/claude_cli.py:1011 applies the key and session-marker strip after env construction at the single spawn door.

pipeline/jobfit/claude_cli.py:1037 reads the envelope's subtype/is_error and raises a typed error instead of trusting the exit code; pipeline/jobfit/llm/base.py:592 is the one corrective re-prompt for the second parse (model text to caller JSON).
pipeline/jobfit/claude_cli.py:271 repo_scan is paired with permission mode `plan` (plus a write-tool denylist), and pipeline/jobfit/claude_cli.py:587 refuses an unscoped Bash grant on a scanned repo.

pipeline/jobfit/claude_cli.py:240 VERIFIED_CLI_VERSION pins the dated flag and probe rows and logs a drift warning; pipeline/jobfit/llm/capabilities.py:37 PROVIDER_CAPABILITIES is the matrix use cases are checked against (unsupported_caps), so a use case is refused or rerouted rather than failing at runtime.

pipeline/jobfit/llm/base.py:505 floors the attempt timeout to 1 s, and config.py:69 accepts any positive timeoutS, so a tiny configured timeout is honoured instead of being floored as misconfiguration and silently selects the floor. The rest of the ladder is realized: one shared predicate (registry.py:189) and named descent reasons.

pipeline/jobfit/claude_cli.py:838 decides READY from loggedIn alone; authMethod/subscriptionType are recorded but never checked against the expected billing shape, so a probe whose auth record moved off the seat still reports ready. The technique requires asserting the whole record. The env-through-the-door half is realized at claude_cli.py:806.
pipeline/jobfit/claude_cli.py:3 the engine is headless `claude -p` batch with no person inside the turn; a grep for approval|can_use_tool|permission-prompt in both CLI modules finds nothing to route.
pipeline/jobfit/claude_cli.py:1061 session_id is only copied into the result; a grep for resume|--continue finds no resumed thread, so calls are stateless.
pipeline/jobfit/claude_cli.py:191 MODES = generate, repo_scan, web_research: there is no edit seam whose shell grants would need deriving.

pairs.registryProposal: fallback-ladder and the golden path's timeout clause say to floor a 'misconfigured tiny timeout' but name no sane minimum. Per transport, the floor should be a dated-capability-matrix row (e.g. measured cold-start plus first-token time for the CLI), so a judge can tell a deliberate short ceiling for a local model from a misconfiguration.
